artifacts.notes: Whole 105-page provider PDF; Bonn lists 95 printed pages. Syriac title leaf at PDF 101 and Arabic Mass-reading heading at PDF 99 were inspected.
artifacts.rights_basis: The printed 1901 pericope table is public domain in the United States by expired publication term. Bonn ULB marks this exact digitized title (https://digitale-sammlungen.ulb.uni-bonn.de/content/titleinfo/3207188) Public Domain Mark 1.0. Retain the unchanged mechanical 105-page PDF with Bonn attribution; the mark is a status notice, not a licence. Register as a Mass-reading table, without asserting collation to the 1877 calendar.

work.author: Syriac Catholic Church
work.description: A Syriac Antiochene Mass-reading table, a complementary pericope witness rather than a complete celebrant missal.
work.title: Qudikus Qurbono: table of Epistle and Gospel readings at Mass
